judgment.reason: The rewritten query misassigns the questions: it asks the 'Readable Read' paper (1603.08868) how it identifies bipolar disorder individuals and asks the bipolar paper (1906.01010) which linguistic features it applied, whereas the original asks how each of the two papers answers BOTH questions (bipolar identification and linguistic features). Additionally, the comparison-target framing ('前者/后者') inverts which paper is the baseline for which question and drops the explicit requirement to state comparability per each question. The standalone query also introduces an unsupported implication that the Readable Read paper identifies bipolar individuals. The referents (two named papers) are retrievable, but the meaning constraints and assignment of questions are not preserved.
